  swarm [prompt]
      Run Ruflo-backed swarm routing, then fan out Kimi, GPT-OSS, and Ollama as needed.

  doctor
      Check that the launcher and offload entrypoints are available.

  route [prompt]
      Print the lane that btw would choose without executing it.

  @kimi [prompt]

  @gpt-oss [prompt]

  ai triage "What should I change first?"
  ai ruflo "Route this feature"

}

require_cmd() {
  if ! command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Missing required command: $1" >&2
    exit 127
  fi
}

gemini_policy_guard() {
  require_cmd python3
  python3 "$ROOT_DIR/Scripts/gemini-policy-guard.py"
}

run_gemini_safe() {
  gemini_policy_guard
  require_cmd gemini
  exec gemini "$@"
}

run_gemini_prompt() {
  local prompt="$1"
  gemini_policy_guard
  require_cmd gemini
  exec gemini -p "$prompt"
}

join_prompt() {
  printf '%s' "$*"
}

print_section() {
  local title="$1"
  local file="$2"
  printf '\n[%s]\n' "$title"
  if [ -s "$file" ]; then
    sed -n '1,220p' "$file"
  else
    echo "(no output)"
  fi
}

run_triage() {
  local prompt="$1"
  local tmpdir claude_out gemini_out codex_out
  local pid_claude pid_gemini pid_codex status

  require_cmd claude
  require_cmd codex
  gemini_policy_guard

  tmpdir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ai-triage.XXXXXX")"
  claude_out="$tmpdir/claude.txt"
  gemini_out="$tmpdir/gemini.txt"
  codex_out="$tmpdir/codex.txt"

  trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT

  (
    claude --print "$prompt" >"$claude_out" 2>&1
  ) &
  pid_claude=$!

  (
    run_gemini_prompt "$prompt" >"$gemini_out" 2>&1
  ) &
  pid_gemini=$!

  (
    codex exec --cd "$ROOT_DIR" "$prompt" >"$codex_out" 2>&1
  ) &
  pid_codex=$!

  status=0
  if ! wait "$pid_claude"; then
    status=1
  fi
  if ! wait "$pid_gemini"; then
    status=1
  fi
  if ! wait "$pid_codex"; then
    status=1
  fi

  print_section "claude" "$claude_out"
  print_section "gemini" "$gemini_out"
  print_section "codex" "$codex_out"

  return "$status"
}

run_codex_offload() {
  local agent="$1"
  shift

  require_cmd codex
  exec codex exec --cd "$ROOT_DIR" "@${agent} $(join_prompt "$@")"
}

run_offload_lane() {
  local lane="$1"
  shift

  if [[ "${AI_DRY_RUN:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$lane"
    return
  fi

  require_cmd node
  exec node "$OFFLOAD_RUNNER" "$lane" "$@"
}

run_codex_swarm() {
  local prompt="$1"
  local tmpdir kimi_out gpt_oss_out ollama_out
  local pid_kimi pid_gpt_oss pid_ollama status

  if [[ "${AI_DRY_RUN:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf 'kimi\n'
    printf 'gpt-oss\n'
    printf 'ollama\n'
    return
  fi

  require_cmd node

  tmpdir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codex-swarm.XXXXXX")"
  kimi_out="$tmpdir/kimi.txt"
  gpt_oss_out="$tmpdir/gpt-oss.txt"
  ollama_out="$tmpdir/ollama.txt"

  trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT

  (
    node "$OFFLOAD_RUNNER" kimi "$prompt" >"$kimi_out" 2>&1
  ) &
  pid_kimi=$!

  (
    node "$OFFLOAD_RUNNER" gpt-oss "$prompt" >"$gpt_oss_out" 2>&1
  ) &
  pid_gpt_oss=$!

  (
    node "$OFFLOAD_RUNNER" ollama "$prompt" >"$ollama_out" 2>&1
  ) &
  pid_ollama=$!

  status=0
  if ! wait "$pid_kimi"; then
    status=1
  fi
  if ! wait "$pid_gpt_oss"; then
    status=1
  fi
  if ! wait "$pid_ollama"; then
    status=1
  fi

  print_section "kimi" "$kimi_out"
  print_section "gpt-oss" "$gpt_oss_out"
  print_section "ollama" "$ollama_out"

  return "$status"
}

run_ruflo_route() {
  local prompt="$1"

  if command -v ruflo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ruflo hooks route -t "$prompt"
    return
  fi

  require_cmd npx
  npx -y ruflo@latest hooks route -t "$prompt"
}

run_ruflo_swarm() {
  local prompt="$1"
  local route route_lower

  if [[ "${AI_DRY_RUN:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf 'ruflo\n'
    return
  fi

  route="$(run_ruflo_route "$prompt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  route_lower="$(printf '%s' "$route" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"

  if [[ "${AI_TRACE_ROUTING:-0}" == "1" && -n "$route" ]]; then
    printf '\n[ruflo]\n%s\n' "$route"
  fi

  case "$route_lower" in
    *gpt-oss*|*gptoss*)
      run_offload_lane gpt-oss "$prompt"
      ;;
    *ollama*)
      run_offload_lane ollama "$prompt"
      ;;
    *kimi*|*moonshot*)
      run_offload_lane kimi "$prompt"
      ;;
    *swarm*|*parallel*|*fan-out*|*hierarchical*|*hive*)
      run_codex_swarm "$prompt"
      ;;
    *)
      run_codex_swarm "$prompt"
      ;;
  esac
}

run_codex_hint() {
  local prompt="$1"
  local lane
  lane="$(select_btw_lane "$prompt")"

  if [[ "${AI_DRY_RUN:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$lane"
    return
  fi

  case "$lane" in
    swarm)
      run_ruflo_swarm "$prompt"
      ;;
    kimi)
      run_offload_lane kimi "$prompt"
      ;;
    gpt-oss)
      run_offload_lane gpt-oss "$prompt"
      ;;
    *)
      run_offload_lane gpt-oss "$prompt"
      ;;
  esac
}

select_btw_lane() {
  local prompt="$1"
  local prompt_lower

  prompt_lower="$(printf '%s' "$prompt" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"

  if [[ "$prompt_lower" == *swarm* || "$prompt_lower" == *fan\ out* || "$prompt_lower" == *parallel* || "$prompt_lower" == *compare* ]]; then
    printf 'swarm\n'
    return
  fi

  if [[ "$prompt_lower" == *frontend* || "$prompt_lower" == *ui* || "$prompt_lower" == *design* || "$prompt_lower" == *react* || "$prompt_lower" == *interface* ]]; then
    printf 'gpt-oss\n'
    return
  fi

  if [[ "$prompt_lower" == *moonshot* || "$prompt_lower" == *kimi* || "$prompt_lower" == *cloud* || "$prompt_lower" == *complex* || "$prompt_lower" == *deep* || "$prompt_lower" == *architecture* || "$prompt_lower" == *review* || "$prompt_lower" == *audit* || "$prompt_lower" == *security* ]]; then
    printf 'kimi\n'
    return
  fi

  printf 'gpt-oss\n'
}

check_cmd() {
  local label="$1"
  local bin="$2"

  if command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'ok  %s -> %s\n' "$label" "$(command -v "$bin")"
    return 0
  fi

  printf 'miss %s\n' "$label"
  return 1
}

check_lane() {
  local prompt="$1"
  local expected="$2"
  local lane

  lane="$(select_btw_lane "$prompt")"
  if [ "$lane" = "$expected" ]; then
    printf 'ok  route "%s" -> %s\n' "$prompt" "$lane"
    return 0
  fi

  printf 'miss route "%s" -> %s (expected %s)\n' "$prompt" "$lane" "$expected"
  return 1
}

case "${1:-help}" in

    shift || true

    prompt="$(join_prompt "$@")"
    if [ -z "$prompt" ]; then

    status=0

    check_cmd "claude" claude || status=1

# NUDIMMUD claude launcher — shows HUD splash for interactive sessions
# Sits at ~/NUDIMMUD/bin (prepended to PATH) to intercept all launches.

if [[ "${NUDIMMUD_SPLASH_SHOWN:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
  _interactive=1
  for _arg in "$@"; do
    case "$_arg" in
      --print|-p|--version|-h|--help|--output-format) _interactive=0; break ;;
    esac
  done
  unset _arg

  if [[ "$_interactive" = "1" ]]; then
    _G='\033[38;2;180;234;144m'
    _G2='\033[38;2;56;87;36m'
    _AU='\033[38;2;92;184;0m'
    _GR='\033[38;2;168;168;168m'
    _CY='\033[38;2;180;234;144m'
    _RS='\033[0m'

    printf "\n"
    printf "${_AU}  ◆ CLAUDE CODE${_RS}  ${_G2}──────────────────────────────────────${_RS}\n"
    printf "  ${_GR}%-14s${_RS}%s\n"       "MODEL"     "claude-sonnet-4-6"
    printf "  ${_GR}%-14s${_CY}%s${_RS}\n" "WORKSPACE" "$(basename "$PWD")"
    printf "  ${_GR}%-14s${_RS}%s\n"       "SESSION"   "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d  %H:%M')"
    printf "  ${_G2}──────────────────────────────────────────────${_RS}\n"
    printf "\n"

    unset _G _G2 _AU _GR _CY _RS
  fi
  unset _interactive
fi

export NUDIMMUD_SPLASH_SHOWN=1

# Strip this wrapper's dir from PATH so exec finds the real claude binary
_CLEAN_PATH="${PATH//$HOME\/NUDIMMUD\/bin:/}"
_CLEAN_PATH="${_CLEAN_PATH//:$HOME\/NUDIMMUD\/bin/}"
exec env PATH="$_CLEAN_PATH" claude "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# NUDIMMUD claude launcher — shows HUD splash for interactive sessions.
# Lives at ~/NUDIMMUD/bin (prepended to PATH) to intercept all launches.
# Strips itself from PATH before exec'ing the real binary to avoid recursion.

if [[ "${NUDIMMUD_SPLASH_SHOWN:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
  _interactive=1
  for _arg in "$@"; do
    case "$_arg" in
      --print|-p|--version|-h|--help|--output-format|\
      --dangerously-skip-permissions|--no-update-check)
        _interactive=0; break ;;
    esac
  done
  unset _arg

  if [[ "$_interactive" = "1" ]]; then
    _G='\033[38;2;180;234;144m'
    _G2='\033[38;2;56;87;36m'
    _AU='\033[38;2;92;184;0m'
    _GR='\033[38;2;168;168;168m'
    _CY='\033[38;2;180;234;144m'
    _RS='\033[0m'

    # Read model from settings.json if available; fall back to default
    _SETTINGS="$(dirname "$(dirname "$0")")/.claude/settings.json"
    _MODEL="claude-sonnet-4-6"
    if [[ -f "$_SETTINGS" ]] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      _M="$(node -e "try{const s=require('$_SETTINGS');console.log(s.model||'')}catch(_){}" 2>/dev/null)"
      [[ -n "$_M" ]] && _MODEL="$_M"
    fi
    unset _SETTINGS _M
